payload.title: Overview of Pyleoclim: Efficient & Flexible Timeseries Analysis
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook introduces the Pyleoclim package for timeseries analysis, focusing on creating Series objects from CSV files, and performing spectral and wavelet analyses. It demonstrates how to use Pyleoclim's methods for plotting, standardizing, and analyzing timeseries data. The notebook also highlights method cascading to streamline workflows. The data used is sea-surface temperature from the NINO3 region.
goals: Get acquainted with the Pyleoclim package, namely the objects and their associated methods
Learn to create a Series object from a csv file
Call the default methods for plotting, spectral and wavelet analysis
